summary: Expanded the AI cluster connectivity node using a two-lane funnel. The cleanest reference asset is Astera Labs, but the underfollowed search lane points to adjacent AEC, signal-integrity, PCIe/CXL IP, and active-copper suppliers rather than many pure USD 300M-10B US-listed names. The strongest discovery candidates found in this pass are Credo, Semtech, and Rambus; all require follow-up to separate AI-cluster attach-rate growth from broader data-center or semiconductor-cycle recovery. No buy/sell view is implied.
